author: Mark Atwood
text:
Filing as human alongside JMAP-jfia.19 — proposes a structural typed-Display enforcement (e.g. JmapBackend::Error: SafeDisplay marker trait, sealed). Significant API change: every existing backend impl needs to opt in. The current doc-only MUST-NOT contract is enforced by the server_fail_from_backend handler-layer redaction (which I closed bd:JMAP-jfia.1 for), plus the redaction-canary test pattern documented in workspace AGENTS.md.

Recommendation: the doc-only contract + handler-side redaction is the workspace's current defense-in-depth strategy. A type-level enforcement would be stronger but ALSO ripples through every consumer crate. Defer to major-bump decision.
